description: This file defines the 'Shape' class in the Aws\Api namespace, representing a modeled shape used in AWS SDK API definitions. It contains methods for creating shape instances based on a definition, and retrieving shape properties such as type and name.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents a modeled AWS shape with capabilities to instantiate specific shape subclasses based on a definition.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a specific shape subclass based on the provided definition and shape map.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the shape.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the shape.

methods.name: getContextParam
methods.description: Retrieves the context parameter definition for the shape.
